result.summary: 这篇论文提出并论证了“柏拉图表示假说”：不同神经网络（包括不同架构、训练目标和数据模态）对数据的表示正在趋于一致，并可能收敛到对现实世界（Z）的共享统计模型 [S1.p2][S1.p4]。作者通过综述文献并测量 78 个视觉模型之间、以及语言模型与视觉模型之间的表示对齐，发现模型能力越强、规模越大，表示越对齐 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS3.p5]。作者提出任务通用性、模型容量和简单性偏置三种机制来解释这种收敛 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS2.p2][S3.SS3.p2]，并给出一个理想化世界中对比学习收敛到 PMI 核的形式化分析 [S4.SS2.p6]。论文还讨论了收敛对跨模态训练、翻译和幻觉/偏置的潜在意义，以及模态信息差异、机器人领域尚未收敛等反例与局限 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要探究不同神经网络模型的表示是否正在收敛，以及这种收敛是否有终点和驱动原则 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者提出核心假说：不同模型都在试图表示现实（即生成观测数据的世界的联合分布），因此表示会随规模增大而趋于对齐 [S1.p4]。原文指出，AI 系统在架构和能力上正变得越来越同质化，这使表示收敛成为一个值得研究的问题 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: This paper explores one aspect of this trend: representational convergence.
We argue that there is a growing similarity in how datapoints are represented in different neural network models.
What has led to this convergence? Will it continue? And ultimately, where does it end?
different models are all trying to arrive at a representation of reality, meaning a representation of the joint distribution over events in the world that generate the data we observe.
In short, AI systems are becoming increasingly homogeneous in both their architectures and their capabilities.

method.text: 论文将表示定义为向量嵌入，并用其诱导的核（kernel）来刻画，把表示对齐定义为两个核之间相似结构的相似度 [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。实验中使用互最近邻（mutual nearest-neighbor）指标，即两个核诱导的 k 近邻集合的平均交集除以 k [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。对于跨模态对齐，作者用成对数据集（如 Wikipedia 图像-标题数据集）作为桥梁，分别计算图像核和文本核再测量对齐 [S2.SS3.p5]。此外，作者在理想化世界模型中形式化分析了一类对比学习器，证明其最优解使点积核逼近 PMI 核 [S4.SS2.p2][S4.SS2.p4]。

evidence.quote: We restrict our attention to representations that are vector embeddings.
we define representational alignment as a measure of the similarity of the similarity structures induced by two representations, i.e., a similarity metric over kernels.
we use a mutual nearest-neighbor metric that measures the mean intersection of the $k$ -nearest neighbor sets induced by two kernels, $K_{1}$ and $K_{2}$, normalized by $k$.
To measure cross-modal alignment, we use paired datasets to bridge the two modalities.
For vision and text, we use the Wikipedia captions dataset $\{(x_{i},y_{i})\}_{i}$, composed of images from Wikipedia ( $x_{i}$) and their corresponding captions ( $y_{i}$).

Our contrastive learner tries to classify if a pair is positive or negative by learning a representation $f_{X}\colon X\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{d}$ such that the dot-product kernel approximates the log odds ratio up to some offset
Therefore, the contrastive learners we consider are minimized by a representation $f_{X}$ whose kernel is $K_{\mathsf{PMI}}$ (up to a constant offset).

experiments.text: 在视觉-视觉对齐中，作者评估了 78 个视觉模型（包括 17 个 ViT、1 个随机初始化 ResNet-50、11 个 ResNet-50 和 49 个 ResNet-18），在 Places-365 验证集上用 k=10 近邻、1000 个图像表示计算对齐，并在 19 个 VTAB 分类任务上做线性探测评估表示质量 [S2.SS2.p2][A3.SS1.p1][A3.SS1.p2][A3.SS1.p3]。在跨模态对齐中，作者比较 BLOOM、OpenLLaMA、LLaMA 等语言模型与 ImageNet-21K 分类、MAE、DINOv2、CLIP 等视觉模型，在 WIT 数据集上取 1024 个样本、k=10 近邻计算对齐 [A3.SS2.p1][A3.SS2.p2][A3.SS2.p3]。作者还做了颜色共现案例研究，从 CIFAR-10 图像共现和语言共现中学习颜色表示并与 CIELAB 感知空间比较 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1][A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We expand upon this observation by evaluating the transfer performance of $78$ vision models.
We consider 78 vision models in total:
$17$ ViT models ranging from ViT-tiny to ViT-giant, trained on tasks including ImageNet-21k classification, Masked Autoencoders, DINO, and CLIP, including some finetuned on ImageNet-12k.
To test representation quality, we evaluate linear probing performance on all 19 VTAB classification tasks
To compute the alignment metric, we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over $1000$ image representations computed on Places-365’s validation dataset.
The language model families we consider are BLOOM, OpenLLaMA, and LLaMA.
We mainly consider the popular vision models: classification on ImageNet-21K, MAE, DINOv2, CLIP, and CLIP finetuned on ImageNet-12K.
To compute the alignment metric, we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over 1024 samples from WIT (Wikipedia-based Image Text;).
We conduct a case study to verify that convergence does happen on real data.
We collect color cooccurrence statistics from the CIFAR-10 dataset

findings.text: 视觉模型的对齐随能力提升而增强：在 VTAB 上表现更好的模型形成更紧密的表示簇，而弱模型表示更分散 [S2.SS2.p2]。跨模态上，语言模型的语言建模能力越强，越倾向于与视觉模型对齐，反之亦然；CLIP 模型因显式语言监督对齐更高，但在 ImageNet 分类微调后对齐下降 [S2.SS3.p5]。对齐还能预测下游性能：与 DINOv2 对齐更好的 LLM 在 Hellaswag 和 GSM8K 上表现更好 [S2.SS5.p1]。颜色案例研究表明，从图像共现或语言共现中学习都能恢复大致相同的感知颜色表示 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: The results indicate that models with high transfer performance form a tightly clustered set of representations, while models with weak performance have more variable representations.
we find that the better an LLM is at language modeling, the more it tends to aligns with vision models, as shown in Figure 3.
The converse effect also holds: the better a vision models is, the more it tends to align with LLMs.

We find that CLIP models, which are trained with explicit language supervision, exhibit a higher level of alignment. However, this alignment decreases after being fine-tuned on ImageNet classification (labeled CLIP (I12K ft)).
Figure 4 supports this hypothesis by demonstrating improved performance on commonsense reasoning (Hellaswag;) and mathematical problem solving (GSM8K;) as alignment improves.
Indeed, learning cooccurrence statistics in either domain recovers roughly the same perceptual representation.

limitations.text: 作者承认，不同模态可能包含不同信息，两个模型若访问根本不同的信息就无法收敛到相同表示；其数学论证仅严格适用于 Z 的双射投影，不适用于有损或随机观测函数 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。目前并非所有表示都在收敛，例如机器人领域尚无标准化的世界状态表示方式，硬件昂贵缓慢也限制了训练数据的数量和多样性 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。AI 社区的研究者偏好和“硬件彩票”可能人为导致向类人表示收敛 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。专用智能可能不会收敛，因为其任务间可能共享很少，且捷径可能更高效 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1]。对齐度量本身存在争议，作者主要使用互最近邻指标 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1]。此外，对齐分数仅达到 0.16（理论上限为 1），这一差距是噪声还是重大差异仍未解决 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1]。

evidence.quote: Two different models cannot converge to the same representation if they have access to fundamentally different information.

our mathematical argument in Section 4 only strictly holds for bijective projections of $\mathbf{Z}$, so that the information in all the projections is equivalent to the information in the underlying world.
This will not hold true for either lossy or stochastic observation functions.
While we do expect other modalities will follow similar trends, we have yet to see the same level of convergence across all domains.
For example, in robotics there is not yet a standardized approach to representing world states in the same way as there is for representing images and text.
One limitation lies in the hardware used in robotics, which is often expensive and slow. This creates a bottleneck in the quantity and diversity of training data.
Researcher bias and collective preferences within the AI community have shaped the trajectory of model development.

Additionally, the “hardware lottery” suggests that the success of AI models can also depend on the compatibility of their design with available computational architectures, further contributing to convergent trends.
Our argument only holds for intelligences that are optimized to perform well on many tasks.
Such shortcuts may be more efficient and necessary for continued improvements in specific domains.
However, there is active debate on the merits and deficiencies of all these ways of measuring alignment.
For example, in Figure 3, alignment clearly increases but only reaches a score of $0.16$, according to our mutual nearest-neighbor metric. The maximum theoretical value for this metric is $1$.
We leave this as an open question.
